content:
“Fight rays with rays.”

**Sun Kissed** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Regen radiation damage between the hours of 6 a.m. and 6 p.m.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Quickly regen radiation damage between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. | 00393F74 | 
| ★ | 1 | Slowly regen radiation damage between the hours of 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m. | 00393F72 | 

- 1.0 / 2.5 rads per second.
- Update 66 disabled this perk on ghoul characters.
- Update 65 enabled this perk on ghoul characters.
- Update 62 disabled this perk on ghoul characters.
- Update 61 enabled this perk on ghoul characters.
